newsitem.title: UK: CAMBRIDGE GETS GO-AHEAD FOR FIBROSIS TRIALS. [CORRECTED 09:14 GMT]
newsitem.headline: CAMBRIDGE GETS GO-AHEAD FOR FIBROSIS TRIALS. [CORRECTED 09:14 GMT]

text.p: Britain's Cambridge Antibody Technology Plc said on Friday it received approval from Britain's Medicines Control Agency to start a Phase I/IIa clinical trial with its anti-TGFBeta2 antibody.
(Corrects name of antibody from anti-TGFa2 to anti-TGFBeta2.)
The antibody combats opthalmic fibrosis and has potential to reduce scarring in the central nervous system. The company said patient enrolment for the trials was expected to start next month.
